[EN] [Important] Iridian Wetlands
[ES] [Importante] Humedales Iridianos
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Iridian Wetlands and ask Kurna what to do.
[ES] Ve a los Humedales Iridianos y pregúntale a Kurna qué hacer.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Canyon Trail
[ES] Sendero del cañón
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You see naga corpses everywhere.
[ES] Ves cadáveres de naga por todas partes.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Pass through the Iridian Wetlands Valley.
[ES] Pasa por el valle de los Humedales Iridianos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Manark what happened.
[ES] Pregúntale a Manark qué pasó.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Canyon Trail
[ES] Sendero del cañón
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You followed the trail of what seems to be Elleon.
[ES] Seguiste el rastro de lo que parece ser Elleon.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Follow the canyon trail and head to where Manark sent you.
[ES] Sigue el sendero del cañón y dirígete a donde te envió Manark.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Search for traces of Elleon.
[ES] Busca rastros de Elleon.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Basheek in Iridian Wetlands about Elleon.
[ES] Pregúntale a Basheek en los Humedales Iridianos sobre Elleon.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Will do."
[ES] "Entendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Collect Iridian Poison Plants and deliver them to Basheek deep in the cave.
[ES] Recolecta plantas venenosas iridianas y entrégaselas a Basheek en lo profundo de la cueva.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Defeat the nearby Naga Marauders.
[ES] Derrota a los merodeadores naga cercanos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Meet you there."
[ES] "Nos vemos allí."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Basheek in the Abandoned Camp.
[ES] Habla con Basheek en el campamento abandonado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Defeat Naga Punishers in the Abandoned Camp.
[ES] Derrota a los castigadores naga en el campamento abandonado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Basheek at the Vortex Zone.
[ES] Habla con Basheek en la zona del vórtice.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Flexis Talon
[ES] Garra de Flexis
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill Flexis Hunters in the Vortex Zone and collect their talons.
[ES] Mata a los cazadores Flexis en la zona del vórtice y recolecta sus garras.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the materials to Basheek.
[ES] Entrégale los materiales a Basheek.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Oh, no."
[ES] "Oh, no."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Let's think about that."
[ES] "Pensemos en eso."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Amarre by the path to the prison.
[ES] Habla con Amarre junto al camino hacia la prisión.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
